n3e5d4addff8.s: The AP Irrigation and Livelihood Project Phase-II (APILIP-II) is funded by:
n3e5d4addff8.x: APILIP-II is a JICA-funded irrigation project; the World Bank funds APIIATP, not APILIP-II.

n0761b5dde09.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: World Bank AP Road Sector Project – 850 km
n0761b5dde09.x: The World Bank AP Road Sector Project covers 850 km of MDRs and State highways; 539.45 km and 728.59 km are NDB Phase-II figures and 1,243 km is NDB Phase-I.

n324b5f797af.s: The 2015 tax incentives under Section 94(1) of the AP Reorganisation Act applied to notified backward districts of:
n324b5f797af.x: The incentives covered notified backward districts of both AP and Telangana, not AP alone.

n33b0856cff1.s: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region, launched on 13 November 2025, covers how many districts?
n33b0856cff1.x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region covers 10 districts; it is a region-specific growth plan, not part of the Aspirational Districts Programme.

n27d5cd611ee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about creating a new railway zone?
o: Railways is listed in Entry 22 of List II (State List)
A zone is created by an executive decision of the Ministry of Railways
A zone is brought into being by a gazette notification of the Ministry of Railways
n27d5cd611ee.x: Railways is a Union subject in Entry 22 of List I, not List II; a zone is made by executive decision plus gazette notification.

new.s: Which of the following lenders is a bilateral agency funding projects in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: KfW (Germany) is a bilateral lender, like JICA; the World Bank, ADB and NDB are multilateral.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a source of external assistance for Andhra Pradesh projects?
new.x: HUDCO is a domestic lender, so its loans are not external assistance; AIIB, UNDP and JICA are external lenders.

new.s: The AP Climate Resilient Zero Budget Natural Farming (APCNF) project is funded by:
new.x: APCNF is funded by KfW (Germany), not the World Bank.

new.s: The World Bank-funded APIIATP covers minor-tank villages in how many districts?
new.x: APIIATP covers 565 minor-tank villages across 22 districts.

new.s: How many components does the World Bank-funded AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project have?
new.x: The Rural Inclusive Growth Project has five components, the first being value chain development.

new.s: The AP Health Systems Strengthening project is funded by:
new.x: AP Health Systems Strengthening is a World Bank project.

new.s: The AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project concluded on:
new.x: APIIATP concluded on 31 October 2025 (SES 2025-26).

new.s: What is the size of the World Bank loan for Amaravati Capital City Phase-I?
new.x: The World Bank approved $800 million on 19 December 2024; $788.8 million is the ADB loan.

new.s: Both multilateral loans for Amaravati Capital City Phase-I are disbursed in:
new.x: Both the World Bank and ADB loans for Amaravati Phase-I are disbursed in Japanese yen.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Amaravati Capital City Phase-I funding:
1. The ADB loan is a results-based loan of $788.8 million.
2. HUDCO and NABARD are part of the Phase-I multilateral funding.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The ADB gave a $788.8 million results-based loan; HUDCO and NABARD are domestic loans, not Phase-I multilateral funding.

new.s: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is the first phase of which larger corridor idea?
new.x: VCIC, funded by ADB, is the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor idea.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ADB projects in Andhra Pradesh?
o: ADB funds the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor
ADB is a co-lender for Amaravati Phase-I with the World Bank
new.x: APCRDA implements Amaravati works, not VCIC.

new.s: Under Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in AP, the funding share of KfW : NCEF : APTRANSCO is:
new.x: GEC Phase-I is funded KfW 40%, NCEF 40% and APTRANSCO 20%.

new.s: NDB Phase-I road projects in Andhra Pradesh cover about how many km?
new.x: NDB Phase-I is ₹3,014 crore for 1,243 km; 850 km is the World Bank road project.

new.s: AIIB assistance in Andhra Pradesh is tracked by the Online Works Monitoring System covering how many ULBs?
new.x: The system tracks 800+ projects in 123 ULBs, including AIIB works.

new.s: In the Union Budget 2026-27, the AP Rural Roads EAP head funded by NDB got:
new.x: AP Rural Roads (NDB) got ₹500.99 crore; ₹350 crore went to Roads & Bridges Reconstruction and ₹155.32 crore to APCNF.

new.s: In the Union Budget 2026-27, the Amaravati Integrated Urban Development Programme allocation was routed through:
new.x: ₹432.09 crore was provided for the Amaravati programme through IBRD.

new.s: The Special Assistance Measure for AP, under which the Centre repays EAP loans, was approved by the Union Cabinet on:
new.x: The Special Assistance Measure was approved on 15 March 2017 in lieu of Special Category Status.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about EAP repayment under the Special Assistance Measure:
1. The Centre bears 90% of the EAP cost.
2. It covers EAPs signed between 2015-16 and 2019-20.
3. The largest disbursement was for the Health Systems Strengthening project.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Centre bears 90% of the cost of EAPs signed in 2015-16 to 2019-20; the largest disbursement was for VCIC (₹1,859 crore), not Health Systems Strengthening (₹935 crore).

new.s: Under the Special Assistance Measure, the Centre reported disbursing loans for how many EAPs in AP?
new.x: The Centre reported disbursing ₹7,798 crore of loans for 17 EAPs in AP.

new.s: The AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project is implemented by:
new.x: SERP implements the Rural Inclusive Growth Project; its PMU is headed by SERP's CEO.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: APCRDA implements Amaravati works, not VCIC.

new.s: How many districts were covered by the backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Seven districts were covered: 4 of Rayalaseema and 3 of North Coastal AP.

new.s: Which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides for appropriate grants and a special development package for Rayalaseema and North Coastal AP?
new.x: Section 46(2)-(3) provides for grants and a special package; Section 94(1) covers tax incentives.

new.s: The total backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh (2016-17) amounts to about:
new.x: Rs 50 crore per district for 7 districts gives Rs 350 crore a year.

new.s: The 2015 tax incentives under Section 94(1) apply to units set up between:
new.x: The incentives cover units set up from 1 April 2015 to 31 March 2020.

new.s: How many districts of undivided Andhra Pradesh were covered by the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
new.x: BRGF covered 13 districts of undivided AP (9 in Telangana plus Anantapur, Chittoor, Kadapa and Vizianagaram) out of 250 in India.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Backward Regions Grant Fund (BRGF)?
o: It was delinked from central support in 2015-16
Hyderabad was among the BRGF districts
Vizianagaram was among the BRGF districts
new.x: The 9 Telangana BRGF districts were all except Hyderabad.

new.s: The motto of the Aspirational Districts Programme is:
new.x: The ADP motto is Convergence, Collaboration, Competition, not Compensation.

new.s: How many districts are covered by NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme?
new.x: The ADP covers 112 districts; 250 was the BRGF coverage.

new.s: AP's loss from the 16th Finance Commission stopping revenue deficit grants is estimated at up to:
new.x: AP's loss from the end of RD grants is up to Rs 38,000 crore.

new.s: Rayalaseema accounts for what share of Andhra Pradesh's micro-irrigation?
new.x: Rayalaseema has 71% of micro-irrigation; 43% and 52% are its horticulture area and output shares.

new.s: How many districts does Rayalaseema have now?
new.x: Rayalaseema now has 8 districts; the package covered only 4 of them.

new.s: The Godavari-Penna link Phase I proposes to lift Godavari flood water to the Pennar in how many stages?
new.x: Phase I is a 5-stage lift carrying 73 TMC of Godavari flood water.

new.s: Savara and Jatapu tribes of Uttarandhra are found mainly on which side?
new.x: Savara and Jatapu are on the Srikakulam side; Gadaba, Bagata, Kotia, Porja and Khond are in the Araku/Visakhapatnam agency.

new.s: The Nagavali-Champavathi link in North Coastal Andhra is through which barrage?
new.x: The Nagavali-Champavathi link runs via the Thotapalli barrage.

new.s: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region was launched on:
new.x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region was launched on 13 November 2025.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Visakhapatnam Economic Region:
1. It covers 10 districts.
2. It is part of NITI Aayog's Aspirational Districts Programme.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: VER covers 10 districts but is a region-specific plan, not part of the ADP.

new.s: For Telangana, the Thirteenth Schedule asks Indian Railways to examine setting up a:
new.x: The Act asked Railways to examine a Rail Coach Factory for Telangana and a railway zone for AP.

new.s: In which year was South Coast Railway announced with its headquarters at Visakhapatnam?
new.x: SCoR was announced in 2019; it was gazetted on 4 May 2026.

new.s: The gazette notification for South Coast Railway was issued on:
new.x: The gazette came on 4 May 2026 and SCoR became fully operational on 1 June 2026.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a division of South Coast Railway?
new.x: SCoR has Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal divisions; Rayagada is in East Coast Railway.

new.s: The Rs 184 crore zonal headquarters of South Coast Railway is proposed at:
new.x: The Rs 184 crore HQ is proposed at Mudasarlova; Siripuram has the temporary office.

new.s: How many divisions does South Coast Railway have?
new.x: SCoR has 4 divisions; South Central Railway shrinks to three.

new.s: The Andhra part of the Waltair division became part of which division?
new.x: The Andhra part of Waltair became the truncated Visakhapatnam division of SCoR.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Waltair division split:
1. The new Rayagada division belongs to South Coast Railway.
2. East Coast Railway keeps K-K line revenue through Rayagada division.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Rayagada division is in East Coast Railway, not SCoR; ECoR keeps K-K line revenue through it.
